statement: Keep governed and advisory contract families and generators independent under the shared v2 version.
rationale: ADR-005 keeps advisory context outside gate authority. A shared version label does not merge responsibilities. The two schema generators remain separate so a gate change cannot alter advisory output, or the reverse. Contracts/v2 and contracts/context/v2 remain separate consumer promises even when field names look alike.
assumptions: A future breaking change to either family advances the shared version, not the other family's runtime behavior.
